title: US PANIC: Bond Bloodbath Gets Terrifying as China CANCELS Dollars, Forever
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: 10y past 5.2% and 30y above 5.4%; 5% is not the ceiling; long-term holders losing trust amid $1.9T deficit.
Summit yielded nothing; China dumping Treasuries and buying record gold while benefiting from the Iran war.
Supply offline and possible Chinese restocking could push oil higher; record diesel embeds inflation, forcing Fed hikes.
Hyperscaler spending and $3T off-balance-sheet commitments vulnerable to higher rates; bankruptcies rising.

calls.reason: Structural inflation, huge deficits and foreign Treasury selling (China at lowest since 2008) keep pushing yields up.
calls.quote: if you thought 5% was the ceiling, we really got to update that assumption

calls.reason: China and central banks swapping Treasuries for record gold purchases amid dollar debasement fears.
calls.quote: It does not take a genius to understand what China is preparing for

calls.reason: China imports 40% below pre-war and can add 5m bpd of buying; 1.1m bpd Middle East/Russian supply offline.
calls.quote: They can go into the open market, they can start stockpiling aggressively, and drive global prices sharply higher

notes: Solo macro commentary (no guest). Says yields went past 5.2% 'before the weekend', so recorded the weekend of Sep 26-27; listing date used. 'First 8 months of 2016' is a slip for 2026.
